lock.FINISHED: Tournament finished: the order no longer has any effect.

registrations.seedingHint: This rank decides the first-round pairings. Use the arrows next to it to set it — until kickoff.

seedingHintWaiting.TEAM: This rank will decide the first-round pairings. You'll be able to set it here as soon as two teams are entered.
seedingHintWaiting.SOLO: This rank will decide the first-round pairings. You'll be able to set it here as soon as two players are entered.

registrations.followsRanking: Sorted by the site ranking: each new registration takes its place by rating. The order can still change before the launch if ratings change; reorder the list to lock it — your order will then take precedence.
registrations.followsFrozenDraw: Ranks locked at kickoff from the site ranking: these are the draw's ranks, even if ratings have changed since.
registrations.removed: {name} is no longer among the entrants.

manualConfirm.title: Set the seeding order by hand?
manualConfirm.body: The seeding order currently follows the site ranking. Changing it permanently replaces it with an order set by the staff: the ranking will no longer reorder the list, and new registrations will be added at the end of the list.
manualConfirm.draw: No match exists yet: the first-round pairings will be drawn from this order at kickoff.

removeEntrant.title: Remove {name} from the tournament
removeEntrant.erased: The registration is erased: nothing will show that this entrant took part in the tournament, unlike a withdrawal. The slot goes back to the board.
removeEntrant.registrationOpen: Registration is open: the freed slot can be taken again, and this entrant can register again.
removeEntrant.registrationClosed: Registration is closed: no one can take this slot anymore, and this entrant can't register again unless registration is reopened.

TEAM.forfeitSelfConfirm: Your team will leave the tournament for good.

SOLO.forfeitSelfConfirm: You'll leave the tournament for good.

streamNotice.TEAM: This tournament's matches may be streamed live and recorded, showing your username, your team's name and your in-game results — never a webcam or voice chat. You can object and appear under a neutral name.
streamNotice.SOLO: This tournament's matches may be streamed live and recorded, showing your username and your in-game results — never a webcam or voice chat. You can object and appear under a neutral name.

register.notManager: Only your team's owner and managers can register it for a tournament.

TEAM.title: Register your team for “{name}”?
TEAM.final: The whole team will be entered. It won't be able to unregister itself: only the tournament staff can remove an entrant.

SOLO.title: Register for “{name}”?
SOLO.final: You won't be able to cancel this registration yourself: only the tournament staff can remove an entrant.

danger.title: Destructive actions
danger.rollbackHint: Erasing {stage} reopens the previous round for correction. You can repeat it: round by round, you can go back to the start of the tournament. Note the scores first: nothing is archived.
danger.rollbackHintFinished: Erasing {stage} reopens the previous round for correction. You can repeat it: round by round, you can go back to the start of the tournament. Since the tournament is finished, it will be reopened and its final standings erased. Note the scores first: nothing is archived.
danger.deleteHint: Deleting this tournament removes it from the site for good, with its matches, registrations and standings. Teams and players are kept.

nextRound.sidesHint: The matchup is certain, but the remaining matches will decide who, ranked higher, takes the left side and hosts the game.
nextRound.footnoteRound: Matchups that are certain whatever the score of the remaining matches — barring a referee decision (withdrawal, penalty, double forfeit). The engine only sets up the round once the previous one is over.
nextRound.footnotePlayoffs: Matchups that are certain whatever the score of the remaining matches — barring a referee decision (withdrawal, penalty, double forfeit). The engine only sets up the next stage once the previous one is over.
